title: Saltglass Cavern: The Herbalist's Resonance Tablet
premise: In a crystalline underworld cut by migratory subterranean rivers, the herbalist must isolate the cure from hazardous blooms using a woven specimen satchel.
ending: Recover the Resonance Tablet and return with the restorative field formula; Cavern Chorus can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive shard bloom while evading the mineral sentinel without sacrificing the restorative field formula.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Cavern Chorus to witness the woven specimen satchel.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to harvest a rare living specimen
